title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Two Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases Involving Obscene Articles

articles.content_en:
2. Regarding the issue submitted by your court concerning "how to determine the crime of providing a book number to another person for publishing obscene publications," we agree with your court's opinion, namely: in accordance with the provisions of Article 2, Paragraph 2 of the Decision, where a person provides a book number without knowing that it will be used by another person to publish obscene publications, it constitutes a negligent crime, and such person shall be convicted of the "crime of providing a book number to another person for publishing obscene publications"; where a person provides a book number knowing that it will be used by another person to publish obscene publications, such person shall be convicted and punished in accordance with the provisions of Article 2, Paragraph 1 of the Decision for the crime of publishing obscene publications.
May 27, 1992
